rows.implementation: Declare package only; no import-time I/O or execution.
acceptance: Import is side-effect free.

rows.implementation: Closed JSON parser, bounded integers/strings/AST, duplicate-key rejection, no floats/repr fallback. Preserve existing compiler Expr hashes; new envelopes have their own domain. Add exact hash length checks and portable logical-path/complete-inventory checks; reject Windows trailing/device/case-prefix aliases without normalization.
acceptance: Normal/-O identical behavior; duplicate, surrogate, traversal, nonfinite and depth attacks reject.

rows.implementation: Typed dataclasses plus closed-schema conversion. Formal validity, open-premise status, integrity, search disposition and release are separate fields. Reject unrecognized fields and bool-as-int. Include closed tagged PolicyChoice SELECT(action_id) versus STOP(reason); a legal action named STOP is not termination.
acceptance: Every schema example round-trips; a PASS field cannot become a theorem.

rows.implementation: Compare exact Git trees against PR297 base, closed added/edited/generated sets, file modes and actual bytes; reject undeclared/ignored source providers. Validate unchanged parent objects; no broad wildcard exception. Target the next descendant PR only after an accepted #297 merge and explicit source/pin/evidence comparison; inspected head is not accepted-parent authority.
acceptance: A hidden .lean/.py and deletion of an old claim reject; approved exact delta passes.

rows.implementation: Select explicit frozen parent checkout for historical gates, preserving original source code and source identities. Emit requested-child and checked-parent identities separately. Never mark a historical replay current-head formal validity.
acceptance: Wrong parent SHA, wrong checkout, mislabeled historical PASS and old source receipt all reject.

rows.implementation: Bind source commit/tree, actual compiler version, pinned package objects, checker recipes, profile and target inventory. Exclude run-generated artifacts from content-hash inputs. Evidence lives outside checkout.
acceptance: Changed definition/checker/profile invalidates epoch; reordering JSON keys does not; no self-hash cycle.

rows.implementation: Read exact compiler atlas plus source-only optional cohort without widening old selector. Preserve all memberships, evidence scopes and review backlog. Resolve actual compiled origin not suffix guess.
acceptance: Required root omitted, duplicate identity or swapped source rejects; unreviewed remains explicit.

rows.implementation: Finite typed expression-plan AST with frozen target, permitted constants/local slots, depth/node budgets. No raw Lean/Python/shell text. Empty complete eligible menu yields a tagged STOP result. Retrieval is not proof. Deterministic finite candidate enumeration restores full contracts before actual Lean unification; exclude evaluator gold. Require complete frozen eligible enumeration and return explicit unresolved inventory when incomplete, not an apparent empty-menu stop.
acceptance: Forbidden target/candidate axiom, raw run_cmd, unbounded search and dangling variable reject.

rows.implementation: Run frozen Lean commands in an OS-isolated worker with read-only sources and no network/tokens. Temporary source generated by trusted codec only. Capture exit/stdout/stderr/object hashes and termination reasons.
acceptance: Missing compiler, timeout, crash, wrong .olean and output truncation never count as semantic rejection.

rows.implementation: Independently parse exact compiler output and compare target, telescope/context, sources and proof dependencies. Re-run consumer in a separate clean process. No candidate supplied checker.
acceptance: Forged PASS, hidden premise, theorem of True, source substitution and unadmitted axiom reject.

rows.implementation: Use independently frozen expected gate set and per-gate checker/source/run identity. Host lanes use current source; parent/provider lanes retain their own explicitly required identities. Hashes bind bytes, not authenticity alone. Canonical lane ID is PARENT_REGRESSION. Verify nine required upstream composition inputs; ACCEPTANCE is output, not a required self-receipt. Round3 four-job aggregate remains distinct.
acceptance: Empty/missing/extra/duplicate gates, cross-run artifacts and synthetic evidence in native lane reject.

rows.implementation: Single-writer transactional storage outside repo. Commit with compare-and-swap source generation/revision after verification. Hash-linked immutable events; archived evidence retained; current view derived.
acceptance: Crash/restart, duplicate IDs, stale worker, invalidation race and truncated log reject or recover without false acceptance.

rows.implementation: Read Control-v2 and frozen obstructions as typed historical inputs. Require changed-premise evidence for revival. Do not execute or rewrite frozen #117 scores as current policy.
acceptance: Renamed old failure cannot silently revive; changed proved premise can reopen with explicit scope.

rows.implementation: Wire inventory->FFBBP->Permansson->OoL preflight->host->independent replay->OoL commit. One shared evidence origin; useful rejected/blocked outcomes enter feedback without becoming proofs.
acceptance: Known positive and matched negative run end-to-end; all unfinished leaves remain visible.

rows.implementation: Export deterministic application hypergraph/obligation views outside tracked source by default. Edge IDs include instantiated context/witness/application identity, not only theorem name.
acceptance: Same source+events yields identical semantic bytes; imports never become implication edges.

rows.implementation: Read complete paginated workflow/job artifacts supplied by trusted fetcher; keep pending/skipped/failure states. Classify formal/regression/research jobs and compare frozen scientific outcomes.
acceptance: Success preserving a countermodel is not a new theorem; missing page and running job block complete harvest.

rows.implementation: Subcommands freeze, inventory, plan, run-one, verify, replay, export, harvest, check-descendant. Commands are inert without required source/profile/evidence arguments. Write only fresh output paths outside checkout.
acceptance: Bad args and unavailable native backend return nonzero; no implicit mutable-main or synthetic fallback.

rows.implementation: Document source scope, commands, release labels and nonclaims; link concrete manifests.
acceptance: Every link resolves; distinguish calibration from discovery.

rows.implementation: Closed exact new/edited paths, parent anchor, unchanged objects and authored hashes; unsealed draft rejected by acceptance.
acceptance: Closed schema, independent expected identity and negative mutation tests.

rows.implementation: Separate old reference, selected provider candidate and actual admitted capability; no version-string qualification.
acceptance: Closed schema, independent expected identity and negative mutation tests.

rows.implementation: Independent calibration goal/context declarations and forbidden answer constants; no hidden RHS assumption.
acceptance: Closed schema, independent expected identity and negative mutation tests.

rows.implementation: Finite action grammar, resource ceilings, expected gate/interface sets, phase and domain scope.
acceptance: Closed schema, independent expected identity and negative mutation tests.

rows.implementation: Versioned closed schema with bounded AST, identities, outcomes, typed routes and receipts. Preserve Lean Expr payload as an opaque validated encoding reference rather than inventing its semantics. Enforce minLength=maxLength=64 at all SHA-256 schema positions; schema/runtime newline mutations must agree; include tagged PolicyChoice and RelativePath definitions.
acceptance: Schema checker is required in production; unit-only successful parsing cannot replace it.

rows.implementation: Freeze D02->D05 and separate D02->D04 positive contracts; source-output-drop and other invalid cases. Do not invent a literal D04->D05 root dependency.
acceptance: Expected positive/negative dispositions with exact intended types.

rows.implementation: Synthetic fixtures visibly scoped; include omitted gates, wrong identity, context collision, duplicate origin and late-worker cases.
acceptance: Cannot be admitted to native formal acceptance.

rows.implementation: Pin exact current provider source, selected finite-monitor definitions and consumers. Unverified selected exports remain NOT_ADMITTED.
acceptance: Default frozen-core build alone is insufficient.

rows.implementation: Trusted template materialized only in isolated Lean4.34 provider workspace. Use computedValue_eq_value/computedMaximizer_attains and actual model instance when claimed.
acceptance: All exported types and permitted axioms verified; no .olean transferred to RH.

rows.implementation: New domain profile over shared contracts. Preserve old snapshot helper; verify information needed by exact composition task. Signed/error-bounded arithmetic remains scoped. Apply normalization to the actual object: D05 e is unit; w is nonzero only. Any unit-w operation needs a separate checked scaling view, not mutation of the original Schur packet.
acceptance: Module/type-hash collisions, omitted source/output, masking and origin cloning detected.

rows.implementation: Proof-backed full route interface inventory and explicit conditional contexts. Use host-verified binding receipts, never proposal booleans. Include observed phase and branch coverage.
acceptance: Missing interface, same-type changed witness, unauthorized premise and wrong phase reject.

rows.implementation: Package marker, no automatic provider import.
acceptance: No side effects.

rows.implementation: Stable finite-menu selector, stop state, exact fixed-world check and optional qualified sidecar. Do not assert learned Markov dynamics or global optimality. Closed tagged selection, exact eligible/proposal/count inventory equality, host-derived journal dispatch counts and same-generation revision binding. Fairness is conditional on fixed complete feasible menu and enough budget.
acceptance: Changing P, stale source, forged capability, illegal menu action and starvation controls.

rows.implementation: Parse closed bounded JSON plan into a narrow AST; only allowlisted constants and authorized telescope slots.
acceptance: Compile using host pin; paired semantic mutation rejection with same imports/toolchain.

rows.implementation: Use fresh Lean metavariable context, actual imported constants and typeclass resolution. All remaining goals explicitly reported; no extra assumptions or broad unrestricted tactics.
acceptance: Compile using host pin; paired semantic mutation rejection with same imports/toolchain.

rows.implementation: Export exact target/type DAG/context, retained witness terms, source origins and allowed axioms; no unresolved expression/universe metavariables.
acceptance: Compile using host pin; paired semantic mutation rejection with same imports/toolchain.

rows.implementation: Fresh independent expected-type consumer and transitive axiom/dependency checks; trusted process cannot import proposal-provided extensions.
acceptance: Compile using host pin; paired semantic mutation rejection with same imports/toolchain.

rows.implementation: Optional checked calibration wrapper with complete D02/D05 context. Imports mathematics only. Not a newly registered terminal claim or search target answer available to planner. Retain original unnormalized D05 packets; no norm(w)=1 assumption. Native template is unqualified until actual host build and independent consumer complete.
acceptance: Independent consumer checks exact full type and axioms.

rows.implementation: Independent expected statements, positive/negative source tests and #print axioms; no proof terms or metadata promoted from test success.
acceptance: No hidden source-only conclusion, no global margin or equal-eigenvalue shortcut.

Explicit requested source; no project caches for required cold proof lane. CI profile/prose/workflow lane IDs must agree. Reject missing/cyclic/duplicated lanes and keep original four-job acceptance separate.
acceptance: Exact artifact/lane set and real current head; failed/skipped required jobs fail closed.

acceptance: Exact approved delta and source-bound current regression; original predicates survive.

acceptance: Exact approved delta and source-bound current regression; original predicates survive.

acceptance: Exact approved delta and source-bound current regression; original predicates survive.
